name: exhaustion
_note: Exhaustion is a tiered condition (levels 1-6). Level 1: disadvantage on ability checks. Level 2: speed halved. Level 3: disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Level 4: max HP halved. Level 5: speed reduced to 0. Level 6: death. Each long rest reduces level by 1. Pending: tiered level tracking, speed system, max HP modification, and advantage/disadvantage.
